title: VTC — shared community definitions
description: Shared type for the vtc/community/* family: a community's public profile.

relationshipIdentifierDefault.description: Which identifier form the community expects members to issue relationship credentials under. `attributed` means the member's membership DID, so an edge names them; `pairwise` means a relationship DID unique to each counterparty. A declaration, not an enforcement: the member still chooses per relationship, and a community that wants to require one form does so in its own policy. Absent means the community has not declared one; implementations default to `pairwise`, matching the DTG Credentials recommendation.

registryStatus.description: Trust-registry reachability. Populated on reads; not settable.
